summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Novità (news) feature. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_news.py) covering superadmin access control (org user->403 on list/env/simulate), GET /platform/news & /platform/news/env, POST simulate-release (unknown->404, valid creates drafts with status=bozza, simulated=true, generator in {ai,fallback}), PUT edit (bozza only, 400 on published, sets edited=true, preserves generated_titolo/descrizione), POST publish (sets approved_by+published_at), POST withdraw (bozza->400, pubblicata->ritirata), DELETE (400 on pubblicata, OK on bozza/ritirata), republish from ritirata, user GET /news returns ONLY {id,titolo,descrizione,area,published_at} (verified no admin leaks: release_id, generated_*, approved_by, simulated, source_notes, status), GET /news/unread-count & POST /news/mark-read, publishing a new item re-increments count, withdrawn items disappear from user list, audit returns news_published entries. Frontend: SuperAdmin desktop (1920): sidebar-link-piattaforma-novita -> platform-news-page with news-simulate-panel + news-simulate-2026-10-07-team-mobile button, tabs news-tab-draft (2) / news-tab-published, admin-news-{id} cards with news-edit-{id} opening news-edit-dialog with news-edit-title/text/save. SuperAdmin mobile 390: same page renders with sw=390 no overflow. Org user desktop 1920 + mobile 390 + 375: header-news-button shows 'Novità' label, header-news-count '· 1' on desktop, header-news-badge-mobile '1' on mobile when unread>0; clicking navigates to /novita rendering news-page with news-card-{id}/news-date/news-title/news-text/news-area (date=7 ottobre 2026, Italian locale), newest first, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 375. After visiting /novita, badge disappears on next page load. Mobile screenshot confirms clean card layout with area chip. Total 8/8 frontend assertions on the dedicated mobile pass; 12/12 superadmin+desktop assertions pass in the first run.
critical_code_review_comments: news.py _generate() returns tuples via tuple-unpacking of a 2-tuple + str; works but mildly tricky to read. Minor.

PlatformNews.jsx EditDialog: condition 'item.edited !== false && item.generated_descrizione !== d' always shows the hint for fresh (edited=false) drafts because item.edited===false makes left side false; so the 'Testo generato originale' hint is only visible after a prior edit. Consider showing it whenever current text differs from generated_descrizione so admin can always diff vs original.

News.jsx fires /news and /news/mark-read in parallel on mount; if the page is opened directly and user has no items, mark-read still runs (fine). Consider waiting for /news to resolve before marking read to be fully consistent with 'reset after viewing'. Minor.
